_doc: Lookout Mountain Lariat through the chain (tools/ship_track.sh; V3-PLAN P1, ledger 0048; unshelved 2026-11-01, Kevin: 'Start the lariat'). The draft is the engine's own on the OSM route with the paint centreline wired in, P2 step 1, and the P2 data stages of 2026-10-12 (branch 307a3b7, integrated 2026-11-01): gps (the OSM line from data/osm.cache.json; the paint line it overwrites is kept as data/centerline.previous.geojson first) -> paint_centreline (data/centerline.geojson becomes the paint line again: the OSM line moved onto the paint traced on NAIP 2019, the climb at 1 m) -> remap_config (--write: every vertex index and station in the config follows the line, by station matching; a no-op while the line's md5 matches centerline_frame) -> verify_centreline_paint (hard) -> route_oneway_check (hard; a parked street layout's declaration is judged too) -> elev (3DEP along the paint line + the 40 m grid + the 6 m x 5 m corridor samples; scripts.elevation.heightfield, its profile by station on a 1 m line) -> road_profile (the same profile re-smoothed by station with the declared lid held straight; --write records capture.bridges) -> project -> widths (OSM widths under the identity lock, the 'mountain' profile) -> measured_widths (aerial > published > OSM, in the local frame, no OSM flares or fold floors) -> crossfall (in-footprint 3DEP, the construction standard where the measurement is weaker; status estimated) -> verify_crossfall (the roll-rate gate, hard) -> mesh (scripts.geometry.build_mesh: 1ROAD / the verge / 1GRASS / the walls the data asks for, bridges.l13_seam_rule on; no furniture) -> underlay (data/track.obj into loop.blend as GEN_* collections, scripts/blender/underlay.py). Authoring happens in that blend (AUTH_*, V3-PLAN P3), the prep / exporter / spawn builder run from airoso's scripts/ac (never engine-july: that is San Diego's alone), the three street gates, the two Drive-1 road gates (road inventory, stacked legs) and the Drive-1 verdict (tools/drive1_gates.py: P5's set, the July reference for --force-install) run on the BUILT kn5. The workshop lives OUTSIDE airoso (the sync rails require it). Offline on 2026-11-01 the five data steps before elev reproduced the committed centreline, config, remap and gate reports byte for byte from data/osm.cache.json; elev and widths fetch live (USGS 3DEP, Overpass) and are the first thing the Windows run does.
_owed: First pass = Drive 1 (V3-PLAN A13): the road and the ground on the one layout the config declares, street_full, with road_profile.verge_m 0.4 (D4 A) into install_folder lookout_lariat; D4 B is `SHIP_VARIANT=b_verge bash tools/ship_track.sh lookout-lariat` (track.config.json drive1_variants: verge_m 1.25 into the workshop config, install_folder lookout_lariat_verge, never synced back). Parked in track.config.json _layouts_v3_owed until they return: street_reverse (Drive 3; then steps.author gains layout_dummies and steps.ship gains spawn_kn5 — the chain's multi-layout path, Lake Murray's) and race_acw / race_cw (the race steps race_bands / race_planned_gate / race_author / race_verify / export_race / race_scenery_gate / race_gates still run San Diego's hard-coded STREETS shape: P1 owed, 'the race tools come from Lake Murray'). Not listed because not adapted for this road yet: treefx (make_treefx from config zones), signs (author_signs reads signs.json; the Lariat's A5 pass is owed), lamps (author_lamps_blend from a positions file), the P3 authoring steps (seat_terrain with station matching, cut/fill, the edges). The terrain tiers of P3a (track.config.json terrain.tiers) are not read by the engine's mesh step: the draft's ground is the 40 m 3DEP grid refined to terrain_cell_m near the road plus the corridor samples, as on the four chain tracks. Since 0.17.0 (2026-11-03, ledger 0048 'Drive 1 on the Mac') the mesh step builds P3a's physical tiers itself: a 13.3 m medium grid (terrain_cell_m 13.4), the corridor refined to 1.11 m (corridor_refine_factor 12), graded to the road-building cross-section with the stacked legs held to their own leg (terrain.cross_section.build), and C12 / C13 swept as arcs (hairpin_fit.mesh_fit); the visual view / far / plains tiers are still Drive 2's.
